items.title: Last day to file objection (Einspruch)
items.quote: Die Frist für den Einspruch beträgt zwei Wochen ab Zustellung; einzulegen ist er schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Landkreis Beispielmünde – Bußgeldbehörde.
items.computation: Formal service (Zustellungsurkunde) noted on the envelope as 22.02.2027 (fragments '22.02.20' + '27'). Period of two weeks starts the day after service (§ 187 BGB, § 50 OWiG/StPO § 43) and ends with the same weekday two weeks later: Monday 08.03.2027. 08.03. is Internationaler Frauentag, a public holiday in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, so under § 193 BGB / § 43 Abs. 2 StPO the deadline moves to Tuesday 09.03.2027.

items.title: Pay fine and costs (if no objection)
items.quote: Fälligkeit des Gesamtbetrags: zwei Wochen nach Eintritt der Rechtskraft.
items.computation: If no objection is filed, the decision becomes final when the objection period ends on 09.03.2027. Two weeks later is Tuesday 23.03.2027 (a working day). Total 115.00 + 25.00 + 3.50 = 143.50 EUR. The date is earlier if the decision becomes final sooner (e.g. by withdrawing or waiving objection).

warnings: The delivery date is handwritten and split across the stamp ('22.02.20' and '27'); it was read as 22.02.2027, so please check it on your original envelope, as the deadline depends on it.
8 March 2027 (Women's Day) is a public holiday in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, so the objection deadline moves to 9 March. To be safe, send the objection a few days earlier.
The decision carries 1 point in the Fahreignungsregister. If you object, the court can also decide to your disadvantage.
